browser.method: Five sequential 20-second tests in Codex in-app Chromium on development Mac, fixed medium tier, actual visible DOM measurements. experiment.label: SIMULATED TRAINING EXPERIMENT — NOT HUMAN EFFICACY EVIDENCE

Production Thompson selector/template adapter/Red Force versus uniform random focus/template; identical Beta-based difficulty rule. One abstract Bernoulli assessment per canonical skill/session. Hidden competence is separate from Beta estimates. No tactical physics, human learners or empirical learning-rate calibration.
